verdict.rationale: Better Stack's AI SRE claims to generate an automated post-mortem from the incident timeline and Slack, which covers the 'drafting from the timeline' step. This rests on a single marketing line, and nothing in the pack shows the rest of a postmortem workflow. Missing for 10: postmortem templates, review/approval workflow, publication or sharing of postmortems, in-depth docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the automated drafting.
